introBefore: App preferences. Your name and email are edited under
telegramHint: Get your chat ID by messaging your bot then opening: https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates
timezoneHint: Align reminders and timestamps with where you live.
currencyHint: Pair used by forms and defaults (primary and secondary must differ). Bank movements in pesos/dollars only use DOP or USD when they appear here.
secondaryCurrencyHint: Second currency in the pair (income, expenses, loans, goals, etc.).
localeHint: All UI text follows this preference; dates and number formats adapt to it.
calendarCardPaymentHint: By default each card's minimum payment is shown. Existing events refresh when you reopen the calendar or tap refresh there.
exchangeRateHint: Secondary per 1 primary ({{secondary}} per 1 {{primary}}). Empty or 0: use the stored daily rate (API).
browserPushDescription: With permission you will see OS notifications when the app is in the background (same plain-text content as history). In production your PWA can register for push (needs VAPID on the backend).
browserPushSyncOkToast: Notifications enabled and push subscription synced
browserPushSyncExplain: If push tests fail, register the subscription again (common after granting permission before opening Settings, or after switching browsers).
browserPushSyncIdle: Register or refresh push on this device
browserPushSyncedToast: Push subscription saved on the server
browserPushBlockedHelp: Un-block notifications for this site and reload.
pushTestDescription: Checks VAPID plus the subscription on this device (does not use Telegram). Requires notification permission above and VAPID keys on the server.
telegramTestDescription: Sends a test notification to Telegram to verify wiring.
toastTelegramTestNeedChatId: Set your Telegram chat ID first
toastTelegramTestErrorFallback: Could not send the Telegram test notification
toastPushTestErrorFallback: Could not send the test push notification
whatsappDescription: Link the number where you want reminders from Paulino Finance's central number.
whatsappPhoneHint: Enter the complete number with country code, digits only and without the + sign.
whatsappConsent: I agree to receive Paulino Finance reminders and notifications on WhatsApp.
whatsappPhoneChangedHint: Save and test the new number to enable this channel again.
whatsappWithdrawConfirm: Do you want to withdraw consent and disable WhatsApp notifications?
whatsappLoadError: We could not load WhatsApp. Refresh the status and try again.
whatsappSaveSuccess: WhatsApp saved. Send a test to verify the number.
whatsappSaveError: We could not save WhatsApp. Check the number and consent.
whatsappTestSuccess: Test sent and WhatsApp number verified.
whatsappTestError: We could not send the test. Check the number or the central WhatsApp connection.
whatsappRefreshError: The test was sent, but we could not refresh the status. Select refresh.
whatsappWithdrawError: We could not withdraw consent. Try again.
whatsappTogglePrerequisite: Save the number, provide consent, and complete a test before enabling WhatsApp.
